verdict.rationale: Pulley's fundraising modeling product explicitly supports pro-forma modeling for priced rounds and SAFEs, complex pre/post-financing scenarios, and term sheet scanning, which covers dilution and pro-forma ownership modeling; SAFE conversion is implied via SAFE templates and pro-forma tooling. However, evidence does not explicitly confirm option pool top-up modeling or a specific sharing/collaboration workflow with counsel and investors beyond general term sheet upload. Missing for 10: explicit mention of option pool top-up modeling, explicit share/export/collaboration workflow for scenarios with external parties, and independent/hands-on validation of the modeling accuracy.
